name: [Code: EasterEggs 🐣] The Button Room
desc:
🔥 THE BUTTON ROOM: SURVIVAL ESCAPE 🔥

One room. many buttons. Total chaos. Will you find the exit or trigger a Ragdoll explosion? Every press is a risk. Survive, upgrade, and ESCAPE!

🃏 COLLECT & UPGRADE
Card System: Collect Common to LEGENDARY cards for powerful buffs.
Stat Leveling: Boost your strength, speed, and defense to endure the room.
Quests & Achievements: Complete missions to unlock elite rewards.

⚔️ SURVIVAL MECHANICS
Final boss: Mecha boss with unique attacks, defeat him!
Enemy Waves: Fight off hordes with advanced, physics-based weapon combat.
Devious Traps: Watch your step! One wrong button leads to a surprise.
Luck Machines: Test your luck for top-tier gear and items.
Admin Events: Legendary, chaotic sessions where the rules simply don't exist!

🏆 BECOME THE BEST
Global Leaderboards: Prove you’re the #1 survivor in the world.

👇 Like & Favorite to support the development!

Tags: Survival, Escape, Button, Zombie, Physics, Cards, Quest, Simulator, Ragdoll, Chaos.
